sources.title: LoRA in LLMs and Agentic RAG: The Complete Production Guide
sources.snippet: The one-line answer RAG changes what the model can read. LoRA changes how the model behaves. Agentic RAG decides what should happen next. The strongest production systems combine the three deliberately instead of treating them as competing technologies.

sources.title: Why and where to Use LoRA / QLoRA and RAG? - aiorbitlabs.com
sources.snippet: 10. Conclusion Both LoRA/QLoRA and RAG are essential pillars in the next generation of cost-efficient, privacy-conscious, and high-performance AI systems — especially for Europe's fast-growing AI landscape. Use LoRA / QLoRA when you want to teach your model new behavior or domain expertise.
